Description: Full 32-bit address bus transaction with an expected target device enumeration field. Allows scoreboard to verify the decoder correctly routes to IMEM/DMEM/UART/Timer/GPIO/Cycle_Cnt/Instr_Cnt/Event_Cnt or returns error for UNMAPPED.
Key_Methods: new(); convert2string(); do_copy(); do_compare(); randomize(); get_expected_target()
Signals_Used: addr[31:0], we, wdata[31:0], wstrb[3:0], rdata[31:0], ready, err, exp_target_device (enum)

Description: Drives full-width 32-bit address bus transactions to the SoC top-level bus. Asserts bus_req, waits for bus_ready, captures rdata and err signals. Deasserts req after handshake.
Signals_Used: clk, rst_n, bus_req, bus_we, bus_addr[31:0], bus_wdata[31:0], bus_wstrb[3:0], bus_ready, bus_rdata[31:0], bus_err

Description: Passively samples the top-level bus on posedge clk when req & ready. Captures all bus signals and writes to analysis port. Includes covergroup for all 9 target regions.
Signals_Used: clk, bus_req, bus_ready, bus_we, bus_addr[31:0], bus_rdata[31:0], bus_err

Description: Standard UVM sequencer parameterised on bus_decoder_seq_item.
Container for bus decoder VIP. Conditionally creates driver/sequencer. Monitor always present.
Checks: (1) addresses in mapped ranges receive ready=1 and err=0; (2) UNMAPPED addresses receive err=1; (3) rdata is non-X for valid reads. Reports pass/fail per transaction.
Covergroup with bins for each of the 9 address regions, access type (R/W), and cross coverage.
Iterates through each of the 8 mapped address regions, performing one write and one read per region. Verifies ready=1 and err=0 for all.
Accesses the first and last valid address of each 256-byte or 4KB region (boundary testing). Verifies decoder correctly responds at exact boundaries.
Sends transactions to known unmapped addresses (e.g., 0x0000_3000, 0xFFFF_0000). Verifies bus_err=1 and bus_ready remains 0 or error asserted within 1 cycle.
Drives 10 consecutive transactions with no idle cycles between them (ready de-assert and re-assert). Verifies no transaction is lost and all complete with correct response.
Signals_Used: bus_req, bus_ready, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_rdata, bus_err
